identity.revision_id: Immutable identity for exact wording, options, mappings, and governed metadata.
identity.supersedes_revision_id: Prior revision when wording or mapping changes; null for an initial revision.

content.prompt: Exact test-taker wording for this revision.
content.options: Empty for Likert; otherwise ordered option identities, wording, and one color mapping each.
content.language: BCP-47 language tag; this reconstruction begins with en and does not authorize translation changes.

scoring_target.likert: One intended color with governed construct rationale.
scoring_target.single_select: Exactly one option-to-color mapping for Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green.
scoring_target.authority: Research metadata only until separately approved for runtime.

measurement.core_traits: One or more normalized motivational constructs; never merely a color label.
measurement.behavioral_domain: One normalized primary domain, plus optional secondary domains.
measurement.motivational_tradeoff: The meaningful competing priorities exposed by the item.
measurement.semantic_family: Stable family identity for substantially related measurements.

quality.historical_evidence: Legacy identity, original assignment, audit flags, and observed-use status where available.

governance.revision_rule: Never mutate an approved revision in place. Create a new revision identity and preserve the predecessor.
governance.admission_rule: Every origin is reviewed under the same color-model, motivation, desirability, ambiguity, competency, redundancy, and coverage standards.
governance.production_boundary: This schema and every reconstruction disposition are non-production until separately authorized.
